thread:
alex_cs: Heads-up — we're sending proactive comms for a partial degradation affecting some Dedicated us-east-1 GPU pools. Affected customers we know right now: AcmeCorp, Finlytics, MediHealth. Working on mitigation. Need quick review of draft email + confirmation of ETA from eng.

jordan_am: On it. I'll prep tailored notes for AcmeCorp and MediHealth. Share draft when ready.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-03-20-emb-deg created · Severity: P1 · https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-03-20-emb-deg

mira_eng: Quick tech update: seeing KV-cache runaway growth on a small subset of dedicated inference pools after a model rollback. That caused memory pressure -> increased latencies and occasional 5xx. We're forcing cache eviction and capping per-request KV retention.

alex_cs: Thanks @mira_eng. Can you give an ETA to full recovery and whether we should promise a fallback sooner?

mira_eng: Hotfix rolling now. Deployed to 3/4 hosts in the pool, metrics look good. Expect full rollout in ~18 minutes. Recommend enabling quantized-model fallback for affected customers as a short-term mitigation (less perf but stable).

sam_support: I'll update the runbook and enable fallback routes. Command used:
```
// fallback toggle
redwoodctl routing set-fallback --pool us-east-1-dedicated --model quantized-model-v2 --enable
```
Will notify once done.

helen_cs: Drafting the customer note — keeping it short, factual, and actionable. Proposal below (ready to paste):

alex_cs: (draft)
```
Hi <customer>,

Today at 13:02 UTC we observed partial degradation of inference latency for dedicated pools in us-east-1 that affected some requests to embeddings/semantic-search. Impact: slower responses and occasional errors for a subset of requests. Mitigation: our engineers rolled a hotfix to cap KV cache growth and enabled a fallback model that preserves correctness; metrics show recovery in progress. ETA for full recovery: ~30 minutes from now. Next steps: we'll follow up with a technical RCA within 48 hours and contact your account team to schedule a call if you'd like a live walkthrough. We sincerely apologize for the disruption.

— Redwood Inference Customer Success
```

jordan_am: SGTM. I'll personalize for AcmeCorp and call out any SLA exposure. Offering a pro-rated credit where appropriate.

alex_cs: Can legal sign-off the credit language? @helen_cs to coordinate. Also please add any account-specific notes for renewals/risks.

helen_cs: Legal reviewed. Scheduling 30m account calls with AcmeCorp + MediHealth this afternoon; I'll post invites and dial-ins now.

mira_eng: All hosts in the pool are green and latencies back to baseline. Monitoring for 10 more minutes then we'll move incident to monitoring.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-03-20-emb-deg status updated to 'monitoring' · https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-03-20-emb-deg/updates

alex_cs: Thanks team. I'll send the customer emails now and add notes to the account health dashboard for renewal risk follow-up.
